# NARUTO SHİNOBİ NATİONS

**Minecraft 1.20.1 | Forge 47.4.21 | Version 0.1 Beta | Singleplayer and Server Compatible**

---
## 由于 xxx mod 从 CurseForge 上移除，我将 mod 的名称更改为 Naruto Shinobi Nations。从现在开始，我将继续以这个新名称开发该 mod。未来，我计划添加受法国人、英国人、德国人、俄罗斯人、土耳其人、阿拉伯人、波斯人和中国人等民族启发的基于国家的氏族。然而，这些氏族尚未创建。该 mod 目前处于测试阶段，因此可能缺少许多功能、存在错误且未完成的元素。

该 mod 也在 Modrinth 上以相同的（xxx / Naruto Shinobi Nations）开发者名称正式发布。（而且我有相同的头像）

 

请随意使用我为此 mod 制作的任何内容，包括视觉效果和其他所有内容。没有版权或其他类似限制。祝好 :)

 

# ENGLISH
# E

### A Note From the Developer


Artificial intelligence was used during the development of this mod.

If there is a feature, jutsu, clan, balance change, or improvement that you would like to see, you can share your suggestion. I cannot promise that every request will be added, but I will try to implement the ideas that I am able to create. Development will continue from time to time, and the mod will receive more content and improvements in future updates.

### About the Mod

Naruto Shinobi Nations turns Minecraft into a shinobi progression experience built around clans, chakra natures, Kekkei Genkai, trainable skills, unlockable jutsus, ocular abilities, and a customizable combat bar. Every player can develop a different shinobi. Your starting clan and nature releases are randomized, while your later progression depends on the skills and techniques you choose to unlock.

When you first enter a world, you receive a **Shinobi Origin Card**. Right-click it to discover your clan and your starting nature releases. The current clans are **Otsutsuki, Uchiha, Senju, Uzumaki, Hyuga, and Kurama**. A player can begin with between one and five of the current nature releases: **Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, and Lightning**.

Defeating living creatures grants both **Skill Points** and **Jutsu Points**. Skill Points improve Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Dojutsu, Fuinjutsu, Senjutsu, and Medical Jutsu. Jutsu Points unlock progressively stronger techniques, additional jutsu slots, new nature releases, and eligible Kekkei Genkai. Ninjutsu increases maximum chakra, Taijutsu strengthens barehanded attacks, and Medical Jutsu increases maximum health.

### Main Features

- Six playable clans with different progression paths, passives, scrolls, and techniques.
- Five basic chakra natures and multiple nature-based jutsu lines.
- Sharingan, Mangekyou Sharingan, Rinnegan, Byakugan, Mokuton, and other special progression systems.
- Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Lightning, Wood Release, clan, and ocular techniques.
- Large-scale abilities such as Chibaku Tensei, Shinra Tensei, and Nativity of a World of Trees.
- Automatic chakra regeneration that becomes faster as maximum chakra increases.
- A configurable jutsu bar with up to 20 unlockable slots.
- Server-side player progression that survives death and dimension changes.
- Dedicated-server and multiplayer support.
- Interface and gameplay text translated into 20 languages.

### Basic Controls

| Control | Action |
|---|---|
| `H` | Open the Shinobi Profile |
| `Mouse 4` / `Mouse 5` | Move between jutsu slots |
| Right-click a jutsu item | Assign or remove that jutsu from the selected slot |
| Right-click with a normal item | Cast the selected jutsu only when the slot contains a technique; empty slots preserve normal Minecraft use |
| `O` | Activate or deactivate the selected eye ability |
| `Shift + O` | Cycle through unlocked eye abilities and stages |

### Getting Started

1. Use the Shinobi Origin Card received when entering a new world.
2. Press `H` to inspect your clan, chakra natures, Kekkei Genkai, points, and skills.
3. Defeat living creatures to earn Skill Points and Jutsu Points.
4. Use the scrolls associated with your clan, natures, and Kekkei Genkai to unlock techniques in order.
5. Assign unlocked jutsu items to the combat bar and select them with `Mouse 4` or `Mouse 5`.
6. Increase your skills to meet stronger jutsu requirements and expand your chakra, health, and combat power.

### Supported Languages

English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Turkish, Polish, Indonesian, Italian, Dutch, Czech, Ukrainian, Thai, and Vietnamese.

> This is a beta release. Balance, visuals, performance, progression requirements, and individual techniques may change during development.
